name: Hand of Dagun
summary: The Hand of Dagun is a relic sought by Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge. It is one of three items he requests in exchange for Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: A Relic for Bonegrip
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip asks for the Hand of Dagun alongside two other relics. He needs all three before he will give you a copy of Yagyin's Digest, a text tied to beginning a new chapter of his order.

faq.q: What is the Hand of Dagun?
faq.answer: The Hand of Dagun is a relic Gerrig Bonegrip requests with the Star of Xil'yeh and the Legacy Heart.

faq.q: Who wants the Hand of Dagun?
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge asks you to bring him the Hand of Dagun and two other relics.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig Bonegrip need it?
faq.answer: Gerrig needs the Hand of Dagun as one of three relics he requests before giving you a copy of Yagyin's Digest.

faq.q: What does the Hand of Dagun do?
faq.answer: The Hand of Dagun is said to carry a poison that mutates its victim into a member of an old race.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Gerrig Bonegrip's request offers a chance to help begin a new chapter of his order.

attribution: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)
